changes.comment: Clients and daemons find each other in `/tmp/rushd-<uid>` (or `$RUSHD_RUNTIME_DIR/rushd-<uid>`) whatever `TMPDIR` or `XDG_RUNTIME_DIR` says. A listener publishes its socket with a hard link and removes its socket and ownership record on close only while they are still its own. The runtime folder must be an owned directory, not a symbolic link, and reapers skip records they do not own.
